body:
vertexSlotGNN.pt is the model used by vertexgnn::GNNVertexProducerAlpaka (cms-sw/cmssw#51862) through
FileInPath("RecoVertex/PrimaryVertexProducer/data/vertexSlotGNN.pt"). 13 track features, 220 vertex slots, md5 3689ae78771e37c176a3c470530ede89.
title: Add the vertex-slot GNN TorchScript model
